title: “Wise Woman”, Karla Cardillo
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder July 5, 2018

Source media unavailable.

Sadly we have lost Karla Cardillo our “wise woman”, artist and friend. Karla lost her battle with lung cancer, her daughter stated Tuesday.

We will miss her constant smile and love of life. Karla’s kind heart was felt by all that knew her. “Living on the Cape, a whole new world has opened up to me. The excitement of the ocean and of the constantly changing atmosphere has inspired my vision to see and paint the beauty that is here on the Cape, from the smallest broken shell to the ever-changing ocean. There is beauty in all.”

Posted in WHAT'S NEW
